note: SAS advisory implementation guidance for a provider hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (story MCE-17). Identification only: each service is named so a provider can locate the vendor's own documentation; nothing here evaluates any product or makes any FedRAMP determination about it, and the rule or KSI statement governs. Service names and documentation URLs were captured from the vendor's public documentation on the capture date; in this repository the short service names are written with the OCI prefix so they stay unambiguous. The notes are not vendor text. Deleting this file withdraws the platform (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICE.md, section Removing a third party).

family_guidance.CMU: Use FIPS 140 validated cryptographic modules for federal data: OCI Vault keys protected by hardware security modules, and TLS 1.2 or higher. Record module certificates and validation numbers; document any exception formally.
family_guidance.IEC: Define incident evaluation and reporting procedures with the FedRAMP Reportable Incident test, the Potential Agency Impact N-rating scale, and the class-specific reporting timeframes. Wire detection (OCI Cloud Guard problems, OCI Threat Intelligence matches, OCI Monitoring alarms) to an on-call process that can meet the clock.
family_guidance.MAS: Define the Minimum Assessment Scope narrowly and defensibly: identify every information resource that handles federal data or whose compromise would affect it, justify each exclusion, and keep the inventory machine-generated (OCI Search exports across the tenancy) so it stays current.
family_guidance.VDR: Run continuous vulnerability detection across every in-scope resource (OCI Vulnerability Scanning for hosts and container images, OCI OS Management Hub patch reporting), meet the class cadences for sample and drift detection, track mitigation and remediation against the timeframes, and honor CISA KEV due dates.

ksi_guidance.KSI-CED-RAT: Review all training content and completion on a defined cycle; keep the review dated and owned. Where completion records live in a learning system, export them on the same cycle. Evidence: review records with reviewer, date and outcome, plus the updated training register.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CMT-LMC: Log and monitor every modification to the offering: OCI Audit events for every tenancy API call, retained through OCI Logging service connectors to an OCI Object Storage bucket in a separate compartment, OCI Events rules with OCI Notifications on writes made outside the pipeline's principal. Evidence: audit retention and connector configuration, event rule inventory, notification history.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CMT-RMV: Deploy changes by redeploying version-controlled resources through OCI Resource Manager stacks from OCI DevOps pipelines, not by editing live resources. Evidence: pipeline deployment records diffed against OCI Audit write events; stack drift detection results.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CMT-RVP: Review change management procedure effectiveness on a cycle: measure failed changes, rollbacks and out-of-band changes, and adjust the procedure. Evidence: dated reviews with metrics and resulting changes.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CMT-VTD: Automate testing and validation of changes in OCI DevOps: pre-deployment tests, policy checks on OCI Resource Manager plans, OCI Vulnerability Scanning of images in OCI Container Registry, post-deployment verification. Evidence: pipeline run records showing each gate passed per change.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-DFP: Strictly define functionality and privileges for infrastructure and services: least-privilege policy statements scoped by compartment in OCI IAM with Identity Domains, OCI Security Zones policies that prevent insecure configurations, OCI Access Governance reviews. Evidence: policy statement exports, security zone inventory, access review records.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-EIS: Class-varying (optional/MAY at Class B, required at Class C): automated services persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state. On Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: OCI Cloud Guard responder rules that remediate detected problems, OCI Security Zones that block non-conforming changes, OCI OS Management Hub for instance state. Evidence: responder execution history, zone policy records, OS state reports over time.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-IBP: Persistently check third-party machine-based resources against the original provider's documented secure-configuration benchmarks: OCI Cloud Guard detector recipes aligned to published benchmarks, OCI OS Management Hub baselines. Evidence: problem counts per recipe over time.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-MAT: Minimize attack surface and lateral movement: private subnets with service gateways for platform access, OCI Security Zones policies that deny public buckets and public IP assignment, OCI Network Firewall at segment boundaries. Evidence: zone policy inventory, network design records, OCI Cloud Guard public-exposure problems trend.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-OFA: Review resources for high availability and rapid recovery: deployment across availability and fault domains, load balancer health checks, OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery plans, tested recovery. Evidence: architecture inventory with domain coverage, recovery test records.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-RNT: Limit inbound and outbound network traffic: network security groups and security lists that deny by default, OCI Network Firewall for egress control, OCI Web Application Firewall on public entry points. Evidence: rule exports, OCI Cloud Guard open-port problems, firewall coverage inventory.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-RVP: Review protection against denial of service and unwanted activity: OCI Web Application Firewall rate limiting and protection rules, OCI Threat Intelligence enrichment of OCI Cloud Guard problems. Evidence: protection coverage inventory and dated effectiveness reviews.
ksi_guidance.KSI-CNA-ULN: Use logical networking to enforce traffic flow controls: virtual cloud network segmentation, route tables, OCI Zero Trust Packet Routing policies for identity-based paths, flow logs in OCI Logging. Evidence: network architecture records, flow log analysis, path verification results.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-AAM: Automate the lifecycle and privileges of all accounts, roles and groups: OCI IAM with Identity Domains provisioning from the identity provider, group-based policy grants, OCI Access Governance campaigns, automated deprovisioning on termination. Evidence: provisioning logs, campaign records, orphan-account checks.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-APM: Use passwordless authentication where feasible (FIDO2 authenticators), otherwise phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication enforced by sign-on policies in OCI IAM with Identity Domains; eliminate long-lived API keys. Evidence: sign-on policy exports, OCI Audit sign-in analysis, API key inventory.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-ELP: Ensure each user and device can only access what it needs: OCI Access Governance access reviews, least-privilege policy design, OCI Bastion for administrative access without public endpoints. Evidence: access review records, unused-access findings and their closure.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-JIT: Use a least-privileged, role-based, just-in-time authorization model: time-bound group membership granted with approval and expiry through OCI Access Governance request workflows; no standing privileged grants. Evidence: request records with approvals and automatic expiry.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-SNU: Use appropriately secure authentication for non-user accounts and services: instance principals and resource principals for workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure; no long-lived API keys for services; rotate any unavoidable secrets in OCI Vault. Evidence: API key inventory, secret-age reports, OCI Vault secret rotation status.
ksi_guidance.KSI-IAM-SUS: Disable or secure privileged accounts in response to suspicious activity: OCI Cloud Guard problems and OCI Threat Intelligence matches wired to automated responders (disable API keys, suspend users) with on-call escalation. Evidence: response runbooks plus executed-response records with timestamps.
ksi_guidance.KSI-INR-AAR: Generate after action reports for incidents and incorporate lessons persistently. Evidence: after action reports linked to incidents, with tracked improvement actions and closure.
ksi_guidance.KSI-INR-RIR: Review incident response procedure effectiveness on a cycle, including exercises. Evidence: dated reviews, exercise records, and procedure updates that resulted.
ksi_guidance.KSI-INR-RPI: Review past incidents for patterns and previously missed vulnerabilities. Evidence: periodic pattern-analysis reports referencing the incident register.
ksi_guidance.KSI-MLA-ALA: Class-varying (optional/MAY at Class B, required at Class C): a least-privileged, role/attribute-based, just-in-time authorization model governs access to log data by data sensitivity, and is persistently reviewed. On Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: log groups in a dedicated compartment, time-bound policy grants for log access requested through OCI Access Governance, OCI Logging access policies. Evidence: policy statements on the logging compartment, grant records, periodic access reviews of the log store.
ksi_guidance.KSI-MLA-EVC: Persistently evaluate and test the configuration of machine-based resources, especially infrastructure as code: policy-as-code in OCI DevOps on OCI Resource Manager plans, OCI Cloud Guard configuration detectors in runtime. Evidence: pipeline policy results per change and problem counts over time.
ksi_guidance.KSI-MLA-LET: Maintain and review a list of resources and event types that will be logged, monitored and audited, and confirm those activities occur: the register mapped to OCI Logging service logs and custom logs per resource type. Evidence: the logging register plus log configuration exports proving each listed source emits.
ksi_guidance.KSI-MLA-OSM: Operate a SIEM or similar for centralized, tamper-resistant logging: OCI Logging service connectors to an OCI Object Storage bucket with retention rules in a separate compartment, OCI Log Analytics or another SIEM for analysis, restricted access. Evidence: connector and retention rule configuration, access policies.
ksi_guidance.KSI-MLA-RVL: Persistently review and audit logs: automated detections (OCI Cloud Guard detectors, OCI Monitoring alarms, OCI Log Analytics detection rules) plus a documented human review cadence for what automation cannot judge. Evidence: detection inventory, alert dispositions, review records.
ksi_guidance.KSI-PIY-GIV: Generate real-time inventories automatically from authoritative sources: OCI Search queries across the tenancy as the inventory of record, exportable on demand. Evidence: on-demand inventory exports with timestamps proving real-time generation.
ksi_guidance.KSI-PIY-RES: Demonstrate and review executive support for security goals persistently: executive sponsorship in the charter, recurring leadership reviews of posture, funded remediation. Evidence: dated leadership review records and funding decisions tied to security goals.
ksi_guidance.KSI-PIY-RIS: Review the effectiveness of security investments persistently: track spend against measurable outcomes (findings closed, coverage gained) and adjust. Evidence: periodic investment-effectiveness reviews with metrics and resulting decisions.
ksi_guidance.KSI-PIY-RSD: Review the effectiveness of security and privacy in the SDLC against CISA Secure By Design principles: pipeline security gates, secure defaults, threat modeling. Evidence: SDLC review records mapped to Secure By Design principles with improvement actions.
ksi_guidance.KSI-PIY-RVD: Operate and persistently review a vulnerability disclosure program: a public intake channel, triage SLAs, and periodic effectiveness review. Evidence: the published policy, intake and triage records, dated program reviews.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SCR-MIT: Persistently identify, review, and mitigate supply chain risks: supplier vetting, dependency review, risk register entries with mitigations. Evidence: the supply chain risk register with review dates and mitigation status.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SCR-MON: Automatically monitor third-party software for upstream vulnerabilities: OCI Vulnerability Scanning of hosts and images in OCI Container Registry, OCI Application Dependency Management for dependency vulnerabilities in builds, software bill of materials tracking, advisory feeds. Evidence: scan results over time, advisory response records, SBOM currency.
ksi_guidance.KSI-RPL-ABO: Keep backups aligned with defined recovery objectives: OCI Object Storage and block volume backup policies matching the stated recovery point objective, cross-region replication where the objectives require, OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery plans. Evidence: backup policy configuration, job success history, restore points against objectives.
ksi_guidance.KSI-RPL-ARP: Maintain a recovery plan aligned with objectives, covering roles, procedures, and dependencies. Evidence: the plan with review dates and alignment to the stated RTO and RPO.
ksi_guidance.KSI-RPL-RRO: Define recovery time and recovery point objectives and keep them current. Evidence: documented RTO and RPO with rationale and review history.
ksi_guidance.KSI-RPL-TRC: Test the capability to recover from incidents and contingencies: restore tests, OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery switchover and drill runs, game days, measured against objectives. Evidence: test records with measured times against objectives and corrective actions.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-ACM: Manage configuration with automation and review drift persistently: infrastructure as code as the source of truth (OCI Resource Manager stacks with drift detection), OCI Cloud Guard configuration problems, OCI OS Management Hub for instance state, automated remediation where safe. Evidence: drift findings and their resolution over time.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-ASM: Automate management, protection, and rotation of keys, certificates, and secrets: OCI Vault key rotation, OCI Certificates for certificate lifecycle and renewal, OCI Vault secret rotation. Evidence: rotation status across all three, alerts on failures.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-EIS: Persistently evaluate resources for security improvement opportunities and implement them: OCI Cloud Guard problem triage with tracked adoption of fixes, widening OCI Security Zones coverage over time. Evidence: problem trend plus a record of improvements shipped.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-PRR: Class-varying (optional/MAY at Class B, required at Class C): plans, procedures, and resource state are persistently reviewed after changes to limit and remove unwanted residual elements that could affect confidentiality, integrity, or availability of federal customer data. On Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: post-change review of OCI Search results and OCI Audit diffs for orphaned resources, cleanup through the pipeline. Evidence: post-change review records, residual-resource cleanup logs.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-RUD: Class-varying (optional/MAY at Class B, required at Class C): unwanted federal customer data is removed promptly when an agency requests it per customer agreements, including from backups where appropriate (e.g. data spill or usage change). On Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: deletion procedures that cover OCI Object Storage object versions, block volume backups and OCI Full Stack Disaster Recovery copies. Evidence: data-removal request handling records, backup-scoped deletion procedures and logs.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-SIN: Encrypt or otherwise secure information from unwanted access or modification: customer-managed keys in OCI Vault, TLS 1.2 or higher in transit, OCI Security Zones policies that require customer-managed keys and block public access. Evidence: zone policy inventory, key usage records, OCI Cloud Guard encryption problems.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-VCM: Class-varying (optional/MAY at Class B, required at Class C): the authenticity and integrity of communications between machine-based information resources is persistently validated using automation. On Oracle Cloud Infrastructure: mutual TLS between services, OCI Zero Trust Packet Routing identity-based network policies, signed inter-service requests. Evidence: identity validation records, automated integrity-verification records.
ksi_guidance.KSI-SVC-VRI: Use cryptographic methods to validate the integrity of machine-based resources: signed container images in OCI Container Registry with digests pinned in deployment, OCI Vulnerability Scanning results bound to image digests, signed pipeline artifacts. Evidence: signature or digest verification records in the pipeline.
